programmes.d: A weapons expert and a prisoner join forces to avert a catastrophe.

Nicolas Cage (CON AIR) is Will Gerard, a family man whose wife, Laura (January Jones of MAD MEN), is attacked. A stranger, Simon (Guy Pearce of THE KING'S SPEECH) offers revenge on the attacker in exchange for a favor from Will.
A professor (Nicolas Cage) deciphers a mysterious code foretelling future calamities. Can he somehow avert them?
Oscar winner Nicolas Cage stars in this taut, action-packed tale of a notorious arms dealer who sold weapons to dictators and successfully outran the law for nearly twenty years.
A weapons expert and a prisoner join forces to avert a catastrophe.
As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.
